name: Inma no Hakoniwa
source:
An RPG about trying to escape from a succubus's miniature garden!

A man from a poor countryside village heads to the big city to earn money in order to save it. But on the street, he is captured by a succubus and trapped in her miniature garden. There's no way he'll allow himself to become food for this succubus, so he plans an escape.

*As the hero is a weak countryside villager, he doesn't have any fighting capability.
The game is about walking and talking, and possibly getting raped by a succubus.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ264757.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一款关于试图逃离魅魔微型花园的角色扮演游戏！

一个来自贫穷乡村的男人前往大城市赚钱以拯救城市。但在街上，他被一个魅魔抓住，并被困在她的微型花园里。他不可能让自己成为这个魅魔的食物，所以他计划逃跑。

*由于英雄是一个弱小的乡村村民，他没有任何战斗能力。
游戏的内容是走路和说话，还有可能被魅魔强奸。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ264757.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
